pdf_page_count takes the password of an encrypted PDF

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import Xberg

let pdfBytesData = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: "pdf/password_protected.pdf"))
let pdfBytesBytes = Array(pdfBytesData)
let result = try Xberg.pdfPageCount(pdfBytes: pdfBytesBytes, password: "")
print(result)
```
